verdict.rationale: Tavily documents real bulk operations of its own. Extract accepts a batch of up to 20 URLs per request and reports per-URL failures separately in failed_results. Crawl and Map traverse hundreds of paths in parallel from a single call. However, batching is capped at 20 items and limited to Extract, with no documented bulk/batch search endpoint or asynchronous batch-job API for arbitrary item lists. missing for 10: bulk search across many queries, batch sizes beyond 20 URLs, async batch job management, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk behavior.
